name: dobe_A_bulk
desc: Do NOT change the head, face, ears, eyes, expression or muzzle at all. Only change the body below the neck: make it a much bigger, heavier hulking brute than now - a much broader, wider, thicker chest and shoulders, huge thick arms and big fists, and a much heavier, fatter, soft gooey lower body that sags and melts into a very wide, thick, glossy goo puddle, with lots of thick drips sliding off the arms and chest. Keep the same pink and yellow marble colors and the same pixel art style.
